questions.question: She said that she had already left before I arrived, but she didn’t mention where she was going. If she had told me, I wouldn’t have been so surprised.
options: She was surprised that she hadn’t mentioned her plans.
She was annoyed that she had lied about her plans.
She regretted not giving me any details about her trip.
She expected me to ask her about her plans anyway.
questions.answer: She was surprised that she hadn’t mentioned her plans.

They were discussing whether to _______ the new marketing campaign. Some thought it was a great idea, while others felt it was too risky.
